# NetEngineerLab

> Free network engineering calculators, topic hubs and guides for fiber, PON, switching, data-center power and telecom planning. Published in English, Chinese (zh-CN) and Spanish where a translation exists.

Canonical site: https://netengineerlab.com/
Chinese homepage: https://netengineerlab.com/zh/
Spanish homepage: https://netengineerlab.com/es/
Tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/
Chinese tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/zh/
Spanish tools directory: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/es/
Topics: https://netengineerlab.com/topics/
Sitemap: https://netengineerlab.com/sitemap.xml

## Languages

Active locales are English (`en`), Chinese (`zh-CN`) and Spanish (`es`). `x-default` is English. A tool or guide has an hreflang alternate only when that locale page exists. Tool URLs stay `/tools/<slug>/`, `/tools/<slug>/zh/` and `/tools/<slug>/es/`.

## Calculator hubs

- PON and fiber calculators: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/pon-fiber-calculators/
- Switching and bandwidth calculators: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/switching-bandwidth-calculators/
- Data center power and cooling calculators: https://netengineerlab.com/tools/datacenter-power-calculators/

Calculator hubs list tools. Topic hubs explain the design and troubleshooting path. They link to each other and do not share a title.

## Usage notes

Calculations are engineering aids. Validate assumptions, vendor specifications, standards and field conditions before deployment.
